verdict_definitions.UNIFORM_POSITIVE: All 5 seeds exhibit causal ablation drop > 0.0 pp with mean >= 5.0 pp.
verdict_definitions.MIXED_SIGN_VARIABILITY: At least one seed exhibits causal ablation drop <= 0.0 pp, indicating sensitivity to initialization or data ordering.
verdict_definitions.NON_REPLICATED: Fewer than 3 seeds show positive causal drop, or mean causal drop < 5.0 pp.
